description: Profile for the studio's trunk->main repos (the public config repos and the tooling repos). Extends the company default and overrides only what trunk->main changes: the base branch, and a more conservative automerge posture (nothing automerges by default; devDependency patch/minor and GitHub Actions patch/minor/digest do).

It exists because six repos carried `baseBranchPatterns: [main]` verbatim and three of them carried a byte-identical trio of automerge rules. Consume it with `extends: [github>igonzalezespi-apps/renovate-config:config-repo]` INSTEAD OF the default preset - this file already extends it.

Provenance, because absorbing a rule loses its history otherwise: the two automerge opt-ins below carried `Scoped automerge (decision 2026-08-01)` in each of the three repos this was hoisted from, and the catch-all carried `Everything defaults to human review.`. That decision is what this file now holds on their behalf — majors and anything not listed stay human.

packageRules.description: Everything defaults to human review here; the two rules below opt specific classes back in.
Scoped automerge (decision 2026-08-01): devDependencies patch/minor merge themselves once checks are green. Majors stay human.
